empty: This category defines no attributes here.

extra.title: Values no longer in the schema
extra.description: These values are stored, but the category no longer has them here (renamed, removed, or now set per product or per variant). They are kept unchanged until you remove them.

code.functions_none: No active function: rooms cannot ask for anything
code.function_not_served: Functions no channel kind serves: their needs cannot be connected
code.function_no_load_types: Functions without load types: any load is accepted
code.function_no_knx_objects: Functions without KNX objects: no group addresses for them
code.channel_kind_unused: Channel kinds without a channels field: no product can supply them
code.categories_without_mounting_board: Categories mounted on the floorplan whose products have a width: they never reach the board
code.topology_none: No topology: no bus or wireless checks for this system
code.product_bus_current_missing: Products without bus current, and the system has no default
code.system_no_power_supply: No power supply: no product supplies bus current
code.system_no_gateway: No gateway: no product supplies wireless places
code.product_board_without_width: Products on the board without a width (TE)
code.product_channels_missing: Products without their number of channels
code.product_channel_without_limit: Products with channels but no load limit (W or A)
code.system_no_enclosure: No enclosure: no product has enclosure rows

missing.product_board_without_width: Width on the rail (TE): the board cannot place it without one
missing.product_channels_missing: Number of channels: the category has the field, the value is empty
missing.product_bus_current_missing: Bus current the device draws (mA): the line's power supply check skips it
missing.product_channel_without_limit: Load limit per channel (W or A): loads on its channels are not checked
